meaningful_changes: OPEC+ maintained September required production for December; event uncertainty fell but the expected result is neutral rather than fresh bullish alpha.
Official price crosscheck improved to zero differences across comparable SHFE, INE, CZCE and GFEX fields; DCE remains HTTP 412 and volume/OI are not independently checked.
Monday active Brent, WTI and COMEX silver first prints were still unverified at 07:02, so execution gates remain closed.
AG retains the cleanest three-layer directional setup, but the deep night decline and high IV make chasing unattractive.
China CNOOC and Zijin disclosures validate profit transmission but weaken the case for using equities as precise substitutes for SC and AG.
